description: TypeScript SDK for Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API (Graph API v26.0): send text, media, template, interactive and Flow messages, manage media and templates, and receive webhooks with signature checks. Zero runtime dependencies. Node.js 20+, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers.
rules: Install with `npm install @solvejet/whatsapp-cloud-api`. Use the scoped name. The unscoped `whatsapp-cloud-api` and Meta's `whatsapp` are different packages and both are archived.

Create one client: `new WhatsAppClient({ accessToken, phoneNumberId })` and call `client.messages.sendText(to, text)`. The message ID is `res.messages[0]?.id`. Requires Node.js 20+ (global fetch); no axios.

Verify webhook POSTs against the raw, unparsed body: pass the exact string, Buffer, Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer to `verifySignature` or `WebhookHandler`. Never hash `JSON.stringify(req.body)`; re-serialized JSON breaks the HMAC.
`appSecret` for `X-Hub-Signature-256` is the Meta App Secret (App settings > Basic). It is not the access token or the verify token. Load all secrets from environment variables.
`new WebhookHandler({ appSecret })` throws `WhatsAppWebhookError` if `appSecret` is undefined or empty. Omitting the key disables signature checks, so always set it in production.
Answer the GET handshake with `verifyWebhook` or `verifyWebhookQuery` and return its `statusCode` and `body` unchanged (200 with the challenge, or 403).
Parse POSTs with `parseWebhook`, then `extractMessages` and `extractStatuses`. Switch on `message.type` and keep a default branch for message types the SDK does not model.
Free-form messages only work inside the 24-hour customer service window. Outside it send an approved template. Error 131047 is `WhatsAppReEngagementError`; do not retry it in a loop.

`sendTemplate(to, { name, language: { code: 'en_US' }, components })` needs a template already approved by Meta. Create and list templates with `client.templates`. Never invent template names or parameters.

The SDK already retries 429, 5xx and network errors (default 2 retries, backoff). Do not wrap calls in your own retry loop. Branch on `WhatsAppRateLimitError`, `WhatsAppAuthenticationError` and `WhatsAppApiError`.
For message bodies the SDK does not model use `client.messages.sendRaw`. Do not hand-write `fetch` calls to graph.facebook.com when a `client.*` method exists.
Recipients are phone number strings in international format, as in '15551234567'. For users reachable only by username pass `{ bsuid: '...' }`.

For incoming webhooks prefer `createWebhookHandler({ appSecrets, verifyToken })`. Register `webhook.on('message' | 'status' | 'error' | 'call' | 'flow' | 'template' | 'account' | 'group' | 'unknown', fn)`, then call `handleRequest` or `handleDelivery`.

Pass the raw body to `webhook.handleDelivery(rawBody, req.headers['x-hub-signature-256'])` (Express, Fastify), or the whole `Request` to `webhook.handleRequest(request)` (Next.js, Hono, Workers, Bun, Deno). Never pass a parsed JSON body.

`appSecrets` takes one App Secret string or an array. During rotation pass both the old and the new secret so deliveries signed with either are accepted. A delivery with a missing or wrong signature gets 401.

`handleRequest` returns 200 for a valid delivery, 401 for a bad signature or unresolved tenant, 413 over `maxBodyBytes` (3 MiB default), 405 with `Allow: GET, POST` for other methods, and 403 for a failed GET handshake.

By default the handler runs your handlers, then answers (`ackMode: 'after'`). Set `ackMode: 'before'` and pass `waitUntil` to answer first and work in the background. Set `retryOnHandlerError: true` to return 500 so Meta redelivers.

Without `appSecrets` the handler accepts unsigned deliveries and emits warning `WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_UNSIGNED`. `allowUnsigned: true` only silences it. Always set `appSecrets` in production; with secrets set the signature is required.

Meta redelivers webhooks. Pass `dedupe: createMemoryDedupe()` to skip duplicates. It is per process, so for several instances supply your own `WebhookDedupe`. Use `maxEventAgeSeconds` to ignore stale events.

On Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun and edge runtimes import from `@solvejet/whatsapp-cloud-api/web`. It exports `createWebhookHandler`, parsers, `createMemoryDedupe` and `verifySignatureAsync` using Web Crypto and no `node:` imports.

On Workers or Vercel serverless pass `waitUntil` to `handleRequest(request, { waitUntil })`, for example `ctx.waitUntil` on Cloudflare, with `ackMode: 'before'`, so background handlers finish after the response is sent.

Test webhook code with `@solvejet/whatsapp-cloud-api/testing`: `buildWebhookPayload('text')`, then `await createTestRequest({ payload, secret })`, then `webhook.handleRequest(request)`. `signWebhookBody(body, secret)` returns `sha256=<hex>`.

For several Meta apps use `resolveTenant(request)` in `createWebhookHandler` to return `{ appSecrets, verifyToken }` per request. Returning `undefined` rejects the request (401 on POST, 403 on GET). Use `parseWebhookEvents(rawBody)` without a handler.
